name: Essence Rejection
body:
A strange defect or racial quirk has left you utterly devoid of even the vaguest hints of akashic energy, and your chakra energy is unusually resistant to akashic effects.

Prerequisite(s): No essence pool.

Benefit(s): You gain a +1 bonus on saving throws against effects generated by veils. This bonus increases by 1 at 4th level and every 4 levels thereafter (to a maximum bonus of +6 at 20th level).

Special: You lose the benefit of this feat if you gain any essence.
